_doc: Deduplicated counts for the 120 audited paper entry records (v2, 2026-10-14). Definitions: unique_opportunities = distinct signal_id values (one trading idea, rows deduplicated); valid_entries = records measurement-eligible (Class C only: real venue data + genuinely deployed issuance); completed_outcomes = entries with a recorded outcome (close/exit/pnl) — none exist on any audited row.

definitions.unique_opportunities: distinct signal_id values; duplicate rows of the same opportunity collapse to one
definitions.valid_entries: entry records eligible for prediction measurement: real data AND genuinely deployed-issued (Class C only)
definitions.completed_outcomes: entries with a recorded outcome (close/exit/pnl); zero across all 120 rows
